title: Dedicated autoscaler: priority burst controls + utilization reporting enhancement (v46)
author: Asha Patel
description: Improve dedicated autoscaler priority burst controls and expand utilization reporting to surface per-priority queueing, token-bucket drain behavior, and fleet-level throughput guarantees. Motivation: recent production runs showed tail latency regressions for high-priority tenants during burst drain windows and insufficient observability for debugging priority preemption events. This PR adds: 1) per-priority burst token buckets with configurable smoothing and cooldown parameters, 2) reporting hooks that emit per-fleet and per-priority utilization and queued-request histograms, 3) a new optional throughput_guarantee configuration to reserve baseline capacity for named priorities, 4) test coverage and docs updates. Checklist: ensure non-breaking defaults; add feature flag for rollout; update docs and alerting playbook; include integration tests covering burst scenarios and fallback to lower-priority models. Related: Linked Linear ENG-2189 ENG-3412.

discussion_summary: Initial design reviewed and iterated based on reviewer feedback: capped guarantees, feature flag for rollout, added priority_throttle_event, fixed a race in tokenbucket drain. Integration tests initially timed out in CI due to resource constraints; increased test harness timeouts and isolated flakey case. Final CI run green and reviewers approved.
release_notes: Enhancement: per-priority burst token buckets and smoothing; observability: per-priority queue length histograms and utilization gauges; new config throughput_guarantee for baseline capacity reservation; non-breaking defaults and feature-flagged rollout; updated ops docs and alerting playbook.
